Summaries.eng: Running late on her first day as a patrol woman for the Bokuto Police Department, spunky moped rider Natsumi Tsujimoto decides to take several shortcuts, only to be chased down and cited by mechanical genius and expert police driver Miyuki Kobayakawa. Upon arrival at the precinct, Natsumi finds out that her new partner is the same woman who ticketed her earlier. At first, she doesn't trust Miyuki, but in a short period of time, they develop an unbreakable friendship that overcomes traffic accidents, reckless drivers and even the strongest typhoons to hit Tokyo.
Summaries.jpn: ぼくと警察署のパトロール中の女性として初日遅くに走った、元気なモペットライダーの辻本夏美は、機械の天才で専門家の警察ドライバーである小早川美幸に追われて引用されるだけで、いくつかの近道をとることに決めました。 境内に到着すると、夏美は彼女の新しいパートナーが以前に彼女を発券したのと同じ女性であることを知ります。 彼女は最初はみゆきを信用していませんが、短期間で、交通事故、無謀な運転手、そして東京を襲う最強の台風さえも克服する、壊れない友情を築きます。

Aliases: Taiho Shichau zo: You're Under Arrest

Titles.jpn: そしてふたりは出会った

Summaries.eng: Nineteen-year-old Natsumi Tsujimoto is late for her first day at Bokuto Police Precinct in Sumida and is chased down by Miyuki Kobayakawa, an 18-year-old officer who welcomes her after several traffic incidents. A man in a red Mini named Oshō provokes them into a chase and contacts them by radio, claiming he planted fireworks set to explode in two hours. The officers deduce the location under a plane in a park, only to find a boxed lunch instead.
Summaries.jpn: 墨東署に新配属となった辻本夏実は、小早川美幸とコンビを組むことに。だが、性格もまるっきり正反対のふたりは、どうにもソリがあわない。コンビ解消は時間の問題かと思われたが、署内にminiERAターボが乱入するという事件が発生する。

Titles.jpn: 東京タイフーン・ラリー

Summaries.eng: A typhoon warning blankets Tokyo as Natsumi and Miyuki rescue a pregnant stray cat. Ken Nakajima asks Miyuki to repair his motorcycle. During the storm, the officers save a man trapped in a crashed refrigerator truck, caused by a mysterious yellow sports car. A citywide blackout makes finding a veterinarian difficult as the cat goes into labor. The sports car begins tailing them, but Ken intervenes to distract the driver while Natsumi and Miyuki race to find help.
Summaries.jpn: 大型台風が首都圏を直撃。夏実と美幸は容態が悪化した猫を獣医に診せるために、停電と暴風雨の中、工事封鎖中の首都高6号線を激走する。そこに、暴走行為を繰り返していた黄色いランチャが出現。ふたりは猫を救えるのか？

Titles.jpn: 恋のハイウェイ・スター

Summaries.eng: Natsumi and Yoriko Nikaido attempt to arrange an omiai between Miyuki and Ken, but it fails. Miyuki plans to attend a weekend class reunion in Katsuura, while Natsumi convinces Ken to look for her. At the reunion, Miyuki is questioned about romance by former classmates. Returning to the station, she sees Natsumi and Ken together and assumes they are on an omiai. Rumors spread about a love triangle, prompting the chief to order Miyuki and Ken on a date as Natsumi and Yoriko secretly observe.
Summaries.jpn: 頼子の勘違いから署内で美幸にお見合いの噂が蔓延。夏実は煮えきれない中嶋をけしかけるも逆効果に。これを見かねた課長は中嶋と美幸に週末特別デートの指令を出す。署員達が見守る中、見事デートは成功と思われたが……。

Summaries.eng: Natsumi is invited by Tokyo Metropolitan Police headquarters to become the first female bike trooper but hesitates to tell Miyuki. Miyuki already knows and gives her an alarm clock as a farewell gift, later becoming depressed and distracted on duty. Natsumi hints she wants to return while escorting a marathon when a burning truck causes chaos. A runaway semi-trailer heads downhill toward the danger, and Natsumi helps Miyuki and Ken stop it just in time. She resigns from headquarters and returns to the precinct, reuniting with Miyuki.
Summaries.jpn: 夏実は自分の仕事に疑問を抱き始め、本庁での女性白バイ隊員推薦の話を知り、転属を決意。快く夏実を送り出した美幸であったが、夏実のいないことでどこかしっくりいかない。そして、不注意から自分の愛車を壊してしまうことに。
